properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-family hash library inventory in the root lockfile: js-sha3 (under ethers/eth-ens-namehash) and the create-hash/create-hmac/sha.js stack of the browserify crypto shim. Shipped with the app; no direct call site in app code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: md5.js ^1.3.4 (MD5 hash library) declared in static/node/package-lock.json — part of the browserify-crypto shim (EVP_BytesToKey path) bundled into the app's shipped node runtime (ganache 7.9.1, ganache-core 2.13.1, truffle). Legacy/broken hash available in the shipped runtime; no direct app call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 surface of the shipped static/node runtime: sha1-prefixed npm SRI integrity digests (legacy registry integrity, e.g. static/node/package-lock.json:11447 "sha1-1kYQdP6/...") plus sha.js library entries implementing SHA-1 among the SHA-2 family. Records what the bundled runtime ships/verifies; no SHA-1 in app code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Shipped ECDSA/secp256k1 library inventory: secp256k1 is the signing primitive of every Ethereum account on the chains this app serves (keygen, tx signing, recovery), reached indirectly through ganache-core 2.13.1, ganache 7.9.1, web3 1.2.6, ethereumjs-tx, and libp2p (kad-dht/noise, peer-id). Quantum-vulnerable (Shor); changeable via dependency upgrades only — no direct call site exists in the app's own code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Legacy OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey KDF (MD5-based, no salt hardening by default) available inside the shipped browserify-crypto shim used by ganache-core 2.13.1, ganache 7.9.1 and the static/node truffle runtime. Presence is the inventory question; reachable via the bundled node runtime at runtime.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenBSD bcrypt_pbkdf KDF (tweetnacl-based) shipped in the ganache-core/ganache and ssh2 dependency trees; part of the KDF surface of the bundled runtime, not called by the app's own code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CI pipeline for macOS code-signing key material: Travis decrypts the committed PKCS#12 keystore certs/osx.p12.enc with AES-256-CBC (unauthenticated CBC, per-repo key/iv delivered as Travis secure env vars); the keystore password travels as a 'secure:'-encrypted CSC_KEY_PASSWORD at .travis.yml:19-20. Changeable here — CI config and encrypted artifacts are in-repo.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
